name: Xingyi
source: No citywide public parcel source qualified. Official evidence identifies the Xingyi Natural Resources Bureau and Xingyi real-estate registration center as custodial authorities, while Guizhou Natural Resources documents describe provincial registration infrastructure and cadastral data standards.

queries.query: Xingyi China official cadastral map parcel GIS land registry Xingyi Natural Resources Bureau
queries.result: Search did not expose a public Xingyi parcel viewer, cadastral API, downloadable parcel layer, or anonymous geometry endpoint. It surfaced official Guizhou Natural Resources cadastral/registration policy pages and an official Xingyi land-use announcement reference to the former Xingyi Natural Resources Bureau website.

queries.query: 兴义市 自然资源和规划局 不动产登记 地籍图 宗地 GIS 官方
queries.result: Search found the official Guizhou Natural Resources site describing a province-wide real-estate registration cloud platform and cadastral/registration rules, plus an indexed Xingyi Natural Resources Bureau profile and Xingyi registration-center report. No public Xingyi parcel map/API or safe bounded ID+geometry response was found. The search result naming the local bureau was a secondary directory, so it is not treated as first-party registry evidence.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Guizhou Provincial Department of Natural Resources
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Guizhou province; registration cloud-platform and cadastral/registration administration context
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official provincial response says a unified provincial real-estate registration cloud platform was built and shared by 9 prefectures and 88 counties. This is national/provincial agency evidence, not a public Xingyi parcel service.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Xingyi Natural Resources Bureau Real Estate Registration Center (reported by Xingyi Civilization site)
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The report identifies the local registration center and describes online registration service work, but exposes no parcel geometry service or safe public query endpoint.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Xingyi Natural Resources Bureau (announcement reproduced by local news site)
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The announcement names the former Xingyi Natural Resources Bureau website, but it is not itself a parcel data service and the referenced URL is no longer usable.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Guizhou Provincial Department of Natural Resources
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Guizhou/national cadastral and real-estate registration standards
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official standards document defines cadastre, cadastral survey, and real-estate units; it is policy/schema context only and does not provide Xingyi features.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: The indexed official Xingyi Natural Resources Bureau government-service page was unusable from this environment. No login, credentials, token, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS exception was attempted.
The legacy Xingyi land-bureau URL cited by an official land-use announcement no longer served the page.
HTTPS retry of the legacy Xingyi land-bureau URL also returned 404.
The national Real Estate Registration Center policy page was not usable for an Xingyi parcel response; it was used only as discovery context.
No public viewer JavaScript/configuration or service endpoint was available to follow, so no ID+geometry request was invented.
